title: Michael's own memory: frozen at the wheel, bright light, human-shaped blurs
place_text: November 5 missile site, Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I I do remember the simple fact that there's a big bright light in front of us. I do remember that it come close, it go back out and everything.

plain: Michael Johnson, a former Air Force guard, says that one night in 1977 at a nuclear missile site known as November 5, part of Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, he froze at the wheel while a big bright light came close in front of him and his partner Mario Woods, then pulled back. He tells it as his own memory, adding that he saw blurry shapes like humans, the kind of detail that would mean the two men were visited by beings and not just a light.
